_comment: DATA for Rosetta's judged step (design 4.1, 4.4, 4.5). hubRowByName: which forge bundle holds the hub half of a bridge toward each hub; a hub in the graph with no row is refused at submit by name. subjectRenderingAllowList: what the judge is shown of a stranger's field, LIF's list less what a stranger's field never has. vendorFaultRowList: what a failed judge call means, first match wins, tested against the client's error text; retriable rows are waited on within [rosetta-fuse] judgeRetryWaitSecondsList; billedWhenUnanswered says the vendor may have billed a call that never answered, so it stays priced at the estimate. endsUnitOnly: past the bound that one unit is judgeRefused and the job goes on, because the vendor is answering, only not usefully. An error matching no row is a refusal of the answer, not of the vendor.

vendorFaultRowList.reason: the judge's vendor says this service's account is out of credit

the judge's vendor does not serve the configured model
the judge's vendor refused the request
the judge's vendor is limiting this service's rate
the judge's vendor answered with a server fault
the judge's vendor did not answer
